title: Descent of a proper fibre idempotent to a Noetherian model
statement: Let f:X→S be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], s∈S, and e an idempotent in Γ(X_s,O), where X_s is its scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. There exist an open neighbourhood W of s, schemes Y,T, a proper morphism g:Y→T with T locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], p:f⁻¹W→Y, r:W→T, a:X_s→f⁻¹W, q:X_s→Y_{r(s)}, and an idempotent e₀∈Γ(Y_{r(s)},O), such that pg=(f|W)r, a followed by the open inclusion is the fibre embedding, q followed by the model fibre embedding is ap, and q*(e₀)=e. The restriction f|W is as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: General case of Tag 0G7X, Steps 5--8 before applying the Noetherian case

proof.text: Choose an affine open W containing s. Properness of f restricts to f|W by base change [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change]. The map from the restricted fibre to the original fibre is the canonical pullback.map. It is an isomorphism: isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback identifies it as a base change of the isomorphism on residue-field spectra induced by the open immersion W → S [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Pull e back along this isomorphism.

source.place: General case of Tag 0G7X, Steps 5--8 before applying the Noetherian case

proof.text: Apply exists_proper_limit_noetherian to f|W [lem-weil-pbc-proper-limit-noetherian], obtaining directed diagrams Xs, Ss, proper stage maps fs, limiting cones, affine transitions, and compatible projections. Each Ss_i is locally of finite type over Spec(ULift Z). The latter is locally Noetherian, because ULift Z is ring-isomorphic to Z; hence Ss_i is locally Noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft]. No use of the affine-stage clause or the colimit of base global sections is needed.

source.place: General case of Tag 0G7X, Steps 5--8 before applying the Noetherian case

proof.text: Apply the fibre clause of limit_fibre_products_of_affine_transition [lem-weil-pbc-limit-fibre-products], taking its auxiliary diagram T to be Ss, its auxiliary transformation to be the identity and its auxiliary limit map to be the identity. This yields a fibre diagram Q with affine transitions, a limiting cone cQ, stage object equalities with the fibres of fs, and the projection compatibility HEq statements. Transport the apex along cQ.pt = (f|W).fiber s. Every stage fibre is compact and quasi-separated by proper base change over a residue-field spectrum [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change].

source.place: General case of Tag 0G7X, Steps 5--8 before applying the Noetherian case

proof.text: Use Mathlib exists_appTop_π_eq_of_isLimit [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit] to represent the pulled-back e by a stage section t. Its defect t*t-t pulls back to zero. By exists_appTop_map_eq_zero_of_isLimit there is a later stage where this defect vanishes. The image of t there is idempotent, and the cone equation ensures that its pullback is still e. This argument is the proved private helper descend_idempotent.

source.place: General case of Tag 0G7X, Steps 5--8 before applying the Noetherian case

proof.text: Select the resulting stage i. Transport its section and fibre projection along the object equality Q.obj i = (fs.app i).fiber (πS.app i s), using the inverse and forward maps of eqToIso. The HEq projection identity gives compatibility with the fibre embeddings. The section stays idempotent under the induced ring homomorphism, and the inverse/forward composite proves that its pullback is the given section. Compose the fibre projection with the inverse of the initial restriction-fibre isomorphism. Take p and r to be the stage projections and a to be that inverse followed by the restricted fibre embedding. The pullback projection identities give all three required scheme-map equalities.

lean.statement: theorem proper_fibre_idempotent_descent {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (s : S) (e : Γ(f.fiber s, ⊤)) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : ∃ (W : S.Opens) (hs : s ∈ W) (Y T : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ T) (_ : IsProper g) (_ : IsLocallyNoetherian T) (p : (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ⟶ Y) (r : W.toScheme ⟶ T) (a : f.fiber s ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme) (q : f.fiber s ⟶ g.fiber (r ⟨s, hs⟩)) (e₀ : Γ(g.fiber (r ⟨s, hs⟩), ⊤)), p ≫ g = (f ∣_ W) ≫ r ∧ a ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = f.fiberι s ∧ q ≫ g.fiberι (r ⟨s, hs⟩) = a ≫ p ∧ IsIdempotentElem e₀ ∧ q.appTop e₀ = e
